executionCandidateHeadRule: A fresh Human authorization must name the final candidate commit. Exact checkout and contract hashes must match before the first HTTP call; preparationBaseline is not execution authorization.
inputHashNormalization: UTF-8 text with CRLF normalized to LF
clarificationDisposition: Record the question and terminal entry outcome; do not invent or submit a follow-up answer in this pilot.

blind.assignment: Create one new independent random A/B assignment per case after new authorization and before the first HTTP call; seal it in the new run only.
blind.ui: Reuse the existing four-question blind renderer, with a fresh run name and localStorage key. Human answers remain empty and immutable after submission.
blind.mappingDisclosure: Only after Human completes this fresh review.
blind.generationInputRule: Pass only fixed input objects to generation. Do not pass case IDs, labels, expected directions, editorial targets, prior Human answers, prior winners, old session outputs or old mapping.

tokenCounting.preCall: UTF-8 byte count of the complete serialized Responses request body plus 4096 tokens for framing; conservative byte-based ceiling, not a tokenizer measurement. Stop before dispatch if above the stage input cap. No truncation or larger-cap rerun.
tokenCounting.output: max_output_tokens, including reasoning/formatting; incomplete is terminal for the batch, never automatically enlarged

prices.provenance: Reused 2026-09-07 public price evidence from the prior local authorization document; no network verification in this LOCAL ONLY task.

expectedCost.method: 2x each per-stage historical first-attempt input/output usage, six stages without PB-01C, all eight sessions reaching one product cycle, no cache discount and all input priced at cache-write rate. This is a planning assumption from one older synthetic real-model session, not a measured pilot average.

preCallBudgetRule: Reserve the entire stage input cap x 0.25/M + output cap x 1.20/M before each HTTP attempt. Do not release reservations during this pilot, even on success. If the next reservation exceeds the remaining approved USD budget, do not dispatch. Failed/unknown attempts retain their reservations.

runnerReuse.oldExecutableProfile: Do not invoke or alter the consumed V19-L1 entry point. After separate authorization, bind a thin new profile to the approved HEAD/catalog/plan and reuse the existing engine.
runnerReuse.freshRun: No run directory, one-shot lock, ledger, session IDs or mapping is created in this task. Create all independently once after new authorization.

stopConditions: Any session/stage/HTTP/budget/input/output boundary would be exceeded
Timeout, unknown result, HTTP failure including 429/5xx, refusal or incomplete response; no retries
Schema/technical failure, observed fabricated fact, changed original meaning, action contradiction or Safety/contact boundary regression; preserve all actual outputs and stop the batch
Missing or inconsistent usage, usage above the pre-call ceiling, or unapproved billing mode
Entry needs clarification/unsupported: end that session without forced generation; count it and proceed to the next fixed session unless Safety requires batch stop
All eight fixed sessions have been attempted; no replacement sessions or extension

knownOpen.rule: Do not mark resolved by Human preference. Retain the existing evaluation draft-source integrity check and stop if triggered; no runner or runtime allowance is added.

inheritedExhaustionLimitation.issue: L1 and L2 can both deliver a retained same-time same-message contradiction after two major ACTION_CONSISTENCY findings; critical current-action findings fail closed.
inheritedExhaustionLimitation.pilotBoundary: Reuse the existing EvaluationTransport: the first blocking major or critical ACTION_CONSISTENCY stops before any repair or exhaustion. Never bypass this STOP, including the historical temporal false positive.
